raw.query: SELECT f.rho, MIN(f.provisioned_ws / 3869278.4) AS min_ratio, MAX(f.provisioned_ws / 3869278.4) AS max_ratio, BOOL_AND(f.feasible) AS passes_in_aggregate FROM provenance.current_factorial f WHERE f.window_name = 'aggregate' AND f.model = 'chronos' AND f.readiness = 'warm' AND f.policy = 'forecast' AND f.quantile = 'p90' GROUP BY f.rho ORDER BY f.rho;
raw.claimed: The p90-forecast policy achieves cost ratios from 0.89× static at ρ=10 to 0.40× at ρ=25, passing in aggregate at every rating
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded aggregate p90-forecast rows pass at all four ratings (feasible=true) and reproduce both claimed endpoint ratios (0.89x at rho=10 and 0.40x at rho=25) after rounding. Prior verifiers who refuted were misled by looking at old, superseded (is_current=false) factorial rows.
